text:
deploybot: Hotfix rollout rbld/realtime-proxy:20260401-hotfix auto-PAUSED in apac-sin due to surge of 504s on proxy->router connections. Rollout paused and manual decision required. Logs: https://internal.logs/realtime/1729999999 :rotating_light:

hana: Saw the alert. This proxy change touched connection pooling tweaks. Is this expected under load?

ryan: Not expected. We pushed a connection-reuse tweak to reduce socket churn. Repro in perf harness on large fanout. Might overwhelm a backend pool.

sre-oncall: Quick telemetry: apac-sin 504 rate up +3.7% in 10m, tail RT up 120ms. Error heatmap points to router-pool-2.

platform-lead: Options: 1) rollback apac-sin to stable 2) pin patched image with reduced concurrency 3) route around router-pool-2. Which least impact?

hana: Prefer route around pool-2 and canary a patched image with lower max-conns. Lower blast radius and preserves other fixes.

ryan: I can build patched image that forces max_conns=100 for pool-2 only. ETA 20m.

sam: If we route around pool-2 we must update release note and support script. I'll prep both.

sre-oncall: Executing targeted traffic diversion now: ```
# shift traffic away from router-pool-2 in apac-sin
rbctl route update --service=realtime-proxy --region=apac-sin --remove-pool=router-pool-2 --add-fallback=fallback-pool --percent=100 --confirm
```

deploybot: Action recorded: route-update executed by sre-oncall at 2026-04-01T01:40:00Z. Rollout paused.

platform-lead: Good. @ryan when the image is ready we can request a manual expedited pin for apac-sin at 5% to validate. Abort criteria: any sustained 504 increase >0.4% over baseline for 10m.

ryan: Pushed rbld/realtime-proxy:20260401-hotfix.1 (pool-2 max_conns override). Requesting manual pin for apac-sin 5%.

hana: Approving 5% canary for apac-sin, with the SRE abort rule above. @sre-oncall please set a temporary alert and keep pager ready.

sre-oncall: Alerting in place. Dash link: https://dashboards/internal/realtime/apac-sin. Pager will escalate on abort.

deploybot: Manual pin command logged: ```
deploybot pin --image=rbld/realtime-proxy:20260401-hotfix.1 --scope=apac-sin --percentage=5 --reason="pool-2 max_conns override; targeted canary"
```

sam: Draft advisory posted: https://confluence.company/hotfix/20260401-realtime-proxy (short note + what support should tell customers).

ryan: Starting canary now. Will monitor logs for connection resets.

sre-oncall: 12m in: no increase in 504s, connection resets down. Holding to 30m then will recommend ramp.

hana: If 30m clean, ramp to 50% then 100% per cadence. If abort triggers, rollback target: rbld/realtime-proxy:20260328-stable.

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 22m. No regressions. Next check in 8m. :thumbsup:

platform-lead: Thanks all. Keep messages terse here. We'll run a short blameless timeline after deployments complete.
